integrity: All equations and proof steps are supplied explicitly. Exact computational checks independently enumerate all 2,131,016 edge subsets across n=3..7 and sample the all-order high-cardinality identity at n=5..30. Finite tests alone do not prove the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The complete Petersen KG(5,2) polynomial and universal regular-graph top coefficient/cutoff are prior art (Sanal and Vatsalya, 2016). The new claim is full all-order enumeration for n≥6 plus the interior unique-two-cover band. Earlier equivalent counts under bounded-vertex-cover terminology remain a priority risk; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Total domination polynomial and unique-cover band of Kneser graphs
